links.outcome: Accuracy and consistency of LLM answers across repeated runs and prompting strategies
links.effect: CoT-SC improved both accuracy and consistency for GPT-4o and Claude 3.5; Gemini 1.5 Pro with ZS recorded highest consistency; results varied considerably across prompts and domains.
links.quote: For GPT-4o and Claude 3.5, CoT improved the accuracy, and CoT-SC improved both accuracy and consistency.

links.outcome: LLM accuracy on registered dietitian exam questions by prompt type and proficiency level
links.effect: LLMs obtained acceptable overall performance but results varied considerably with different prompts and question domains; RAP was particularly effective for GPT-4o on Expert level questions.
links.quote: Our findings revealed that while these LLMs obtained acceptable overall performance, their results varied considerably with different prompts and question domains.

unlisted_practices: Chain-of-thought with self-consistency prompting to improve LLM accuracy and consistency
Retrieval augmented prompting for expert-level nutrition questions

screen.reason: The study evaluates LLM performance on nutrition exam questions and specifically compares deployment prompting and grounding practices (Zero-Shot, CoT, CoT with self-consistency, and Retrieval-Augmented Prompting) on response accuracy and consistency.
